feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Incoming House majority leader Katherine Clark stresses Democratic unity
entry.summary: As Democrats prepare to take control of the House, incoming majority leader Katherine Clark discusses the party's ambitious agenda and divisions within its ranks.

entry.title: Top House Democrat questions what Trump accomplished in Xi-Putin summit
entry.summary: Rep. Gregory Meeks raises concerns about U.S. alliances after Trump's summit with Xi and Putin. He also discusses Chinese espionage amid the Nvidia scandal.

entry.title: Investors scramble for a piece of AI giant Anthropic in blockbuster IPO
entry.summary: Shares in the maker of the popular Claude artificial intelligence model leapt in first day of trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: President Trump meets with China's Xi and Russia's Putin, House Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries as next speaker of the House, AI giant Anthropic raises more than $100 billion in record-setting IPO.

entry.title: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz escalate
entry.summary: Iran takes the offensive with attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and airstrikes on several countries around the Persian Gulf.

entry.title: As some states move away from the death penalty, Florida prepares to set new record
entry.summary: Florida is set to have its 20th execution of the year Thursday. It's a new record, as other states are moving away from the death penalty.

entry.title: Ben Shapiro on conservative media and the future of the Republican Party
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep sits down with conservative commentator Ben Shapiro to discuss the future of the Republican party.

entry.title: After 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto VI hits store shelves
entry.summary: Millions of gamers are picking up Grand Theft Auto VI, the latest in a best-selling video game series -- many even taking time off work to play. We explore what makes the game so popular.

entry.title: International Court of Justice issues ruling on Myanmar genocide case
entry.summary: The court ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority – a landmark judgment that marks a turning point in international justice. Myanmar has denied the allegations.

entry.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
entry.summary: President Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin have gathered in Shenzhen, China, for a historic trilateral meeting, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament on the agenda.
